2609.26300.title: CompKV: Compensation-Aware KV Selection for Long-Context LLM Inference
2609.26300.paper_summary: Despite their strong performance, large language models (LLMs) are bottlenecked by KV cache memory traffic during long-context inference. Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate LLM inference by computing exact attention over a selected subset of tokens. To recover the contribution of tokens excluded from exact attention, recent methods apply coarse-grained compensation to the omitted attention tail. However, existing methods typically select tokens based on attention mass and only then compensate for the unselected tokens. This decoupled design overlooks their interaction: selection should prioritize tokens that would leave the largest compensation error if omitted. To address this limitation, we introduce CompKV, the first compensation-aware sparse attention framework that divides tokens into blocks and explicitly optimizes selection for the downstream compensation mechanism. Our theoretical analysis shows that the residual left by block-level mean compensation is governed by both block attention mass and within-block logit variation. We approximate this residual using compact block-level statistics, yielding a deployable selection criterion. We further develop an efficient asynchronous implementation. Experiments on RULER and LongBench-Pro show that CompKV performs best among the evaluated sparse baselines while delivering up to a $6.85\times$ self-attention speedup over full attention.
2609.26300.paper_summary_zh: 儘管大型語言模型（LLMs）表現強勁，但在長上下文推理過程中，KV 緩存記憶體流量成為瓶頸。稀疏注意力被廣泛用來通過對選定的標記子集計算精確注意力來加速 LLM 推理。為了恢復被排除在精確注意力之外的標記的貢獻，最近的方法對省略的注意力尾部應用粗粒度補償。然而，現有的方法通常基於注意力質量選擇標記，然後才對未選擇的標記進行補償。這種解耦設計忽視了它們之間的互動：選擇應優先考慮那些如果被省略會留下最大補償誤差的標記。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 CompKV，首個補償感知的稀疏注意力框架，將標記劃分為區塊，並明確優化下游補償機制的選擇。我們的理論分析顯示，區塊級均值補償所留下的殘差受區塊注意力質量和區塊內邏輯變化的影響。我們使用緊湊的區塊級統計來近似這一殘差，從而產生可部署的選擇標準。我們進一步開發了一個高效的非同步實現。在 RULER 和 LongBench-Pro 上的實驗顯示，CompKV 在評估的稀疏基準中表現最佳，同時在全注意力上提供高達 $6.85\times$ 的自注意力加速。
